body: Founder set a new standing MO for GFD: mod API first, then the feature. Found EduScript VM (packages/education/) is already real and live in apps/lobby but has zero reach into apps2/battlegrounds_gui (the FPS 'edu edition' client, specifically prioritized) -- that's the real gap this doc scopes closing, not building a VM from scratch. Referenced Vintage Story's mod API and WC3's World Editor honestly (EduScript's binding pattern already resembles WC3 triggers structurally; Vintage Story's systemic block/entity-behavior hooks are the real depth target). Recommended sharing one destructible-geometry system between GFD and /home/fatbaby/skateboard's own real R6-Siege-style destructibility spec rather than building two. Scripting language left open. Flagged, not scoped: a separate PITVIPER-as-multiverse-portal idea.
title: Mod surface northstar — scoping only, EduScript VM identified as real incumbent
